title: Proto-Indo-European
notes: Deep comparative reconstruction stage; may be unused in current lexical volume.

title: Old English
notes: Includes attested and reconstructed Old English forms; reconstructed OE retains its asterisk in display.

title: Proto-Germanic
notes: Comparative proto-language and selected PGmc input-stage forms.

title: Proto-Northwest Germanic
notes: Intermediate Northwest Germanic reconstructed stages where a Proto-Northwest analysis is explicitly used.

title: Proto-Anglo-Frisian
notes: Optional intermediate stage used when a source or adopted analysis reconstructs an Anglo-Frisian common stage.

title: Pre-Old English / prehistoric English
notes: Historical English-branch stage between common Germanic stages and attested Old English; not a model-internal label.

title: German
notes: Modern German evidence when cited as linguistic data.

title: Middle English
notes: Historical English evidence when cited as a form, not a gloss.

title: Modern English
notes: Modern English forms only when cited as linguistic evidence, not as ordinary gloss prose.
